description_en: Creates a Data Lakehouse Edition cluster
kebab_example: aliyun adb create-db-cluster --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-h --db-cluster-version 5.0 --pay-type Prepaid --vpc-id vpc-bp1at5ze0t5u3xtqn0000 --vswitch-id vsw-bp1aadw9k19x6cis90000 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDBCluster

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454314.html operation to query the region ID of a specific Data Lakehouse Edition cluster
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454314.html接口查看指定湖仓版集群的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The zone ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454314.html operation to query the zone ID of a specific Data Lakehouse Edition cluster
parameters.help_zh:
可用区ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454314.html接口查看指定湖仓版集群的可用区ID
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The version of the Data Lakehouse Edition cluster. Valid values: 5.0
parameters.help_zh: 湖仓版集群的版本，取值：5.0
parameters.name: db_cluster_version

parameters.help_en: The network type of the cluster. Only VPC (Virtual Private Cloud) is supported
parameters.help_zh: 集群网络类型。仅支持VPC（专有网络）类型
parameters.name: db_cluster_network_type

parameters.help_en:
The description of the cluster.
The description cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
集群描述。
不能以`http://`或者`https://`开头。
长度为2~256个字符
parameters.name: db_cluster_description

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.
Prepaid: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型。取值说明：

Postpaid：按量付费。
Prepaid：包年包月
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The subscription type of the subscription cluster. Valid values:
Year: subscription on a yearly basis.
Month: subscription on a monthly basis.

This parameter is required when PayType is set to Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
指定包年包月集群为包年或包月类型。取值说明：
Year：包年类型。
Month：包月类型。

PayType为Prepaid（即包年包月）时，本参数为必填参数
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the subscription cluster. Valid values:
When Period is set to Year, the value of UsedTime ranges from 1 to 3 (integer).
When Period is set to Month, the value of UsedTime ranges from 1 to 9 (integer).

This parameter is required when PayType is set to Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
指定包年包月集群的购买时长。取值说明：
当Period为Year时，UsedTime取值范围为：1~3（整数）。
当Period为Month时，UsedTime取值范围为：1~9（整数）。

PayType为Prepaid（即包年包月）时，本参数为必填参数
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en: The virtual private cloud (VPC) ID
parameters.help_zh: 专有网络ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟交换机ID
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The storage reserved resources. Valid values: 0 ACU to 2064 ACU, in increments of 24. 1 ACU is approximately equivalent to 1 core and 4 GB of memory.
Include the unit when specifying this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
存储预留资源。取值范围：0ACU～2064ACU，步长：24。1 ACU约等于1核4 GB。
参数填写时，需要带单位
parameters.name: storage_resource

parameters.help_en:
The compute reserved resources. Valid values: 0 ACU to 4096 ACU, in increments of 16. 1 ACU is approximately equivalent to 1 core and 4 GB of memory.
Include the unit when specifying this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
计算预留资源。取值范围：0ACU～4096ACU，步长：16。1 ACU约等于1核4 GB。
参数填写时，需要带单位
parameters.name: compute_resource

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to allocate all compute reserved resources to the default resource group (user_default). Valid values:
true (default): All compute reserved resources are allocated to the default resource group.
false: Not all compute reserved resources are allocated to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
计算预留资源是否全部分配给默认资源组（user_default），取值说明：
true（默认值）：是
false：否
parameters.name: enable_default_resource_pool

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key. You can use tags to filter the cluster list. You can specify up to 20 tag pairs. The value of N for each tag pair must be unique and must be a consecutive integer that starts from 1. The value of `Tag.N.Key` corresponds to the value of `Tag.N.Value`.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun`, `acs:`, `http://`, or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
标签键，可以根据标签过滤集群列表。最多20对标签，各个标签对的数字n必须不同，且必须是从1开始的连续整数。`Tag.N.Key`对应的值为`Tag.N.Value`。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`、`acs:`、`http://`或者`https://`开头
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value. You can use tags to filter the cluster list. You can specify up to 20 tag pairs. The value of N for each tag pair must be unique and must be a consecutive integer that starts from 1. The value of `Tag.N.Key` corresponds to the value of `Tag.N.Value`.

The tag value can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun`, `acs:`, `http://`, or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
标签值，可以根据标签过滤集群列表。最多20对标签，各个标签对的数字n必须不同，且必须是从1开始的连续整数。`Tag.N.Key`对应的值为`Tag.N.Value`。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`、`acs:`、`http://`或者`https://`开头
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表信息
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the source AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition cluster. If this parameter is specified, the Data Lakehouse Edition cluster is used to recover from the Data Warehouse Edition cluster
parameters.help_zh: AnalyticDB MySQL数仓版集群的源实例ID，指定该参数时为从数仓版集群恢复湖仓版集群
parameters.name: source_db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup set used for restoration from a backup set.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612318.html operation to query the backup list of the cluster
parameters.help_zh:
基于备份集恢复时，使用的备份集的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612318.html接口查看集群的备份列表
parameters.name: backup_set_id

parameters.help_en: The point in time to which you want to restore data from the backup set
parameters.help_zh: 基于备份集恢复的时间点
parameters.name: restore_to_time

parameters.help_en:
The restoration method. Valid values:
backup: restores data from a backup set. You must also specify the BackupSetId and SourceDBClusterId parameters.
timepoint: restores data to a specific point in time. You must also specify the RestoreToTime and SourceDBClusterId parameters
parameters.help_zh:
恢复方式，取值：
backup：基于备份集恢复，您还需要传入参数BackupSetId、SourceDBClusterId。
timepoint：基于时间点恢复，您还需要传入参数RestoreToTime、SourceDBClusterId
parameters.name: restore_type

parameters.help_en:
The product form. Valid values:
IntegrationForm: integrated form.
LegacyForm: Data Lakehouse Edition
parameters.help_zh:
产品形态。取值为：
IntegrationForm：融合形态。
LegacyForm：湖仓版
parameters.name: product_form

parameters.help_en: The node specifications of reserved nodes, in ACUs
parameters.help_zh: 预留节点规格，单位为ACU
parameters.name: reserved_node_size

parameters.help_en:
The number of reserved nodes. 
Enterprise Edition uses 3 nodes by default, in increments of 3.
Basic Edition uses 1 node by default.
This parameter is required only when ProductForm is set to IntegrationForm
parameters.help_zh:
预留节点数。 
企业版默认为3节点，步长为3。
基础版默认为1节点。
仅ProductForm取值为IntegrationForm时，填写该参数
parameters.name: reserved_node_count

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the key used to encrypt cloud disk data.
This parameter is used only when cloud disk encryption is enabled for the AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
parameters.help_zh:
用于加密云盘数据的密钥ID。
仅当AnalyticDB MySQL集群开启云盘加密时才会使用该参数
parameters.name: kms_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable cloud disk encryption
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启云盘加密
parameters.name: disk_encryption

parameters.help_en:
The region of the source cluster.
This parameter is required for cross-region cloning
parameters.help_zh:
源集群所在的地域。
跨地域克隆时该参数必填
parameters.name: clone_source_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The product version. Valid values:
BasicVersion: Basic Edition.
EnterpriseVersion: Enterprise Edition.
This parameter is required only when ProductForm is set to IntegrationForm
parameters.help_zh:
产品版本。取值为：
BasicVersion：基础版。
EnterpriseVersion：企业版。
仅ProductForm取值为IntegrationForm时，填写该参数
parameters.name: product_version

parameters.help_en:
The secondary zone ID.
The value of this parameter must be different from the value of the ZoneId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
备可用区ID。
本参数和ZoneId参数传入的值不能相同
parameters.name: secondary_zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The secondary vSwitch ID.
The value of this parameter must be different from the value of the VSwitchId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
备虚拟交换机ID。
本参数和VSwitchId参数传入的值不能相同
parameters.name: secondary_vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable SSL encryption. Valid values:

true: SSL encryption is enabled.
false: SSL encryption is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启SSL链路加密功能，取值：

true：开启。
false：关闭
parameters.name: enable_ssl

parameters.help_en: AI节点规格
parameters.help_zh: AI节点规格
parameters.name: ai_node_spec

parameters.help_en: AI节点数量
parameters.help_zh: AI节点数量
parameters.name: ai_node_number

DBClusterId.description_en: The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the default resource group
